paths.title: Codex Academy
paths.tagline: Turn specifications into working software with OpenAI's coding agent
paths.description: A ten-lesson path from your first signed-in Codex task to a full spec-to-merged-PR delivery workflow. Covers reading an unfamiliar repository, writing specs a coding agent can implement correctly, implementing features, debugging failing builds and tests, code review with Codex, building a real landing page from a spec, choosing cloud tasks versus local sessions, verification habits, and end-to-end delivery — with AGENTS.md guidance woven throughout.
